items.reason: The story's Expected title applies to the `/cart` page as a whole, but the page has two renderings: the empty-bag block (checked by TC-PRB-1-01) and the item list. This case covers the other side of that boundary, so a fix that only sets the title in the empty branch, or a regression that changes the heading when items are present, is caught. It runs at e2e because the title and heading exist only in the browser, and it uses `bob` so alice's basket stays empty for TC-PRB-1-01 and TC-PRB-1-02.
